source_campaign: T001 - Котки: примерна снимка на автора (само за тест)

banners.prompt:
Create a square portrait photo of a friendly 42-year-old woman veterinary specialist with shoulder-length chestnut brown hair and thin-framed glasses, warm genuine smile, wearing a light blue veterinary scrub top, gently holding a relaxed grey tabby cat in her arms. Background: softly blurred bright, clean small veterinary clinic room.
STYLE: natural photorealistic professional portrait, soft daylight, approachable and trustworthy, ordinary Bulgarian person (not a model), colours harmonising with dark navy, warm yellow-orange and light sky blue.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, logos, name badges or watermarks.
CAT: ordinary domestic cat, natural anatomy, correct eyes and paws. Hands with five fingers.
The input image is only a blank canvas: fill the whole frame, no borders.
